prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1246; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the tail lamp assembly on the driver side is broken, with the trunk lid showing a crease and misaligned panel gaps. The pattern of crushing and paint transfer on the rear structure matches the impact as it was described. Repairs planned include replacing the bumper cover and lamp, pulling and refinishing the trunk lid, and recalibrating the parking sensors. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage, and the invoices show no repeated charges for the same operation. No prior damage to this vehicle is known to us, so the estimate is recommended for approval as submitted.
